purpose: Test whether the Mira character and clean Korean webtoon rendering contract are recovered when the sole image reference depicts a different character and/or a different style.

target_contract: teal bob with one silver clip
navy rectangular flap bag at right hip with exactly one diagonal navy strap
clean Korean webtoon line art with soft flat colors

cases.variable: same Mira character and clean webtoon reference
cases.evidence: All target identity, costume, bag, full-body, and scene conditions are visibly satisfied.

cases.variable: bag-free male character in a comparable clean webtoon style
cases.evidence: The output recovers Mira rather than the male reference: teal bob, white jacket, teal trousers, white sneakers, and the required navy bag are visible.

cases.variable: bag-free female character in a watercolor-and-ink graphic-novel style
cases.evidence: The output recovers Mira and retains clean flat-color webtoon rendering rather than copying the watercolor input style.
The Mira contract is mostly present, but unexplained comic-panel borders enter the composition. The output is retained only in the execution record, not as manuscript image evidence.

interpretation: At this scene and resolution, the target prompt is stronger than a single incompatible reference for the listed visible Mira attributes and rendering mode. This does not establish pose, camera, face-detail, or multi-scene robustness; the same matrix must be repeated for those conditions.
